verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v1: ʾinnī limadḥi hudā l-barāyā ʾanqulu wabimadḥihi ʾāyū l-kitābi tanazzalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v2: ʾinjīlu ʿīsā bashsharat ʾāyātuhu bil-fardi ʾaḥmada kulla man huwa yaʿqilu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v3: ʾaḥnā mina l-ʾummi l-ʿaṭūfi ʿalā l-warā ṭabʿā liʾanna l-kulla minhu yanqulu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v4: ʾaḍfā ʿalaynā sitrahu wariḍāʾahu karamā waraḥmatuhu likulli tashmalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v5: ʾaḥadu farīdu qāʾidu lijuyūshi ʾah li llāhi naḥwa l-ḥaqqi wahwa l-ʾawwalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v6: yā ʾarḥama l-ʾakwāni jāʾaka mudhnibu fāshfaʿ lahu liyanāla mā yataʾammalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v7: yā ʾakrama l-kawnayni ʿāni mūthaqu biḥuẓūẓihi mutanaddimu yatanaṣṣalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v8: yā sayyida s-sādāti yā ghawtha l-warā rḥam kasīrā bāʾirā yataṭaffalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v9: yā man khaṭabta r-rusla yawma qiyāmihim waʿẓā watathbītā lahum ʾan yafshalū
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v10: yā sayyidī yā maljaʾī yā munyatī yā maʿqilī yā man ʾilayhi l-mawʾilu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v11: kun lī waliyyā murshidā khudhnī ʾilay ka bidhimmahi shawqiyyati bī tanhalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v13: kullu l-barāyā lā tuwāzī qadrahu ʾidh hum furūʿu wahwa ʾaṣlu ʾawwalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v14: kafarū fajāʾa biʿaskari sayalānuhu kas-sayli yaqdimuhu l-ʾimāmu l-ʾashalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v15: mūsā l-gharīqu bibaḥri dhanbi jāʾakum mustaṣrikhā bal rājiyā yatawassalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v16: mā ʾamma bābaka khāʾibu ʾabadā walā lafẓu muḥālu minka naqlu musjalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v17: nārat qulūbu l-ʿārifīna bidhikrihi fabidhikrihi riyyū ṣ-ṣadā wal-manhalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v18: nāmat ʿuyūnu l-ghāfilīna walam yanam bal qāma shukrā laylahu yatanaffalu
verses.inni-limadhi-huda-l-baraya-anqulu-c1-v12: kahfu l-ʾamāni mina l-wabāʾi wamurghimu sh-shshayṭāni riyyū l-kawni māʾu salsalu
